subject: Lost Woods
text: Link can purchase a Deku Nut Upgrade for 40 Rupees in the Lost Woods.

evidence.quote: Get a Deku Nut Upgrade for 40 Rupees in Lost Woods

subject: Fishing Hole
text: Catching a 10 lb. fish at the Fishing Hole awards Heart Piece #15.

evidence.quote: fish for a 10 lb. fish at the Fishing Hole to get Heart Piece #15.

subject: Magic Bean Salesman
text: All 10 Magic Beans can be purchased at Zora's River.

evidence.quote:
Kill Gold Skulltula #25 at Zora's River, buy all 10 Magic Beans, and plant
one at Magic Bean Plot #1.

subject: Lost Woods
text: Wearing the Mask of Truth in a hole in the Lost Woods yields a Deku Nut Upgrade.

evidence.quote:
use the Mask of Truth to get
a Deku Nut Upgrade in a hole in Lost Woods.

subject: Lon Lon Ranch
text: Winning Malon's horse race at Lon Lon Ranch rewards Link with a cow for his house in Kokiri Village.

evidence.quote:
win Malon's horse race in
Lon Lon Ranch to get a cow for your house in Kokiri Village. (Free milk!)

subject: Fishing Hole
text: Catching a big lunker fish in the Fishing Hole at Lake Hylia earns the Golden Scale.

evidence.quote:
fish for a big lunker in the Fishing Hole to get 
the Golden Scale.

subject: Frogs
text: Heart Pieces #27 and #28 are obtained from the frogs at Zora's River.

evidence.quote: Get Heart Pieces #27 and #28 from the frogs at Zora's River.

subject: Biggoron
text: Delivering the World's Greatest Eye Drops to Biggoron results in him fixing the Broken Goron's Sword over 2 days to grant the Biggoron's Sword.

evidence.quote:
Get the World's Greatest Eye Drops from the Lake Hylia scientist, then take
them to Biggoron. Have him fix the Broken Goron's Sword for 2 days to give you
the Biggoron's Sword.

subject: Spirit Temple
text: Clearing the first part of the Spirit Temple as Young Link yields the Silver Gauntlets.

evidence.quote:
Clear the first part of the Spirit Temple as Young Link, killing Gold
Skulltulas #93 through #96, and getting the Silver Gauntlets.

subject: Gerudo Training Grounds
text: Clearing the Gerudo Training Grounds rewards Link with the Ice Arrows.

evidence.quote: Clear the Gerudo Training Grounds to get the Ice Arrows.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Collecting four Heart Pieces assembles a new Heart, contributing toward a maximum total of 20 hearts from 36 Heart Pieces and boss Heart Containers.

evidence.quote:
There are 36 Heart Pieces located within the game, and when combined with the
Heart Containers from bosses, will make up a total of 20 hearts for your health.
Every four pieces will assemble a new Heart for your health.

subject: Skull Kids
text: Standing on the stump facing two Skull Kids in the Lost Woods and repeating their notes on the Ocarina three times rewards a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Drop down to where the target is, and in a corner are two 
Skull Kids with flutes. Stand on the stump and pull out either Ocarina while 
facing them and they'll want you to play a little game. You must play the 
notes they play. If you successfully do it three times (doesn't have to be
consecutively), they'll give you a Piece of Heart.

subject: Back Alley Woman
text: At night, finding the white dog near the house with the man looking out the window and returning it to the woman in the Back Alley rewards Piece of Heart #2.

evidence.quote:
Make sure it's night time... Head into one 
of the houses in the Back Alley to see an obese woman in a white and blue 
striped shirt. She claims her dog is loose and wants her dog back. Head back 
into the main Market, and look for the white dog near the house with the man 
looking out his window. The dog will follow you. Bring the dog back to the 
woman and she'll give you this Piece.

subject: Silo
text: Moving the crates inside the silo at the back of Lon Lon Ranch opens access to a crawlspace containing Piece of Heart #3.

evidence.quote:
Head into the silo at the back of the ranch and you'll see a bunch
 of crates hiding a crawlspace. Move the crates in such a way so you can reach 
 the crawlspace... behind 
 the crawlspace lies the Piece of Heart.

subject: Skull Kid
text: Playing Saria's Song on an Ocarina while standing on the stump before the Skull Kid left of the Lost Woods entrance awards Piece of Heart #4.

evidence.quote:
Head left from the entrance of Lost Woods to find a Skull Kid with
 a flute. Stand on the stump in front of him, whip out any Ocarina you might 
 have, and play Saria's Song. He'll give you this Piece in return.

subject: Dampe
text: Paying Dampe 10 Rupees to dig on dirt patches in Kakariko Graveyard at night eventually unearths Piece of Heart #5 at a random location.

evidence.quote:
Making sure night has just arrived (like, right after you hear the
 howl of a wolf) Dampe will be out wandering the graveyard. For 10 Rupees, 
 he'll dig where he stands... Let him dig once on each section of dirt until he digs up 
 the Piece of Heart.
